description: This file declares functions and classes related to importing and loading serialized torch JIT modules, including various overloads for handling different input formats such as filenames, streams, and readers. It primarily provides APIs for deserializing and initializing torch script modules.

classes.name: caffe2::serialize::ReadAdapterInterface
classes.description: Interface for reading serialized data, used for custom input stream adaptation.

classes.name: torch::jit::DeserializationStorageContext
classes.description: Context object for managing storage during deserialization.

methods.name: import_ir_module
methods.description: Various overloads to import a torch script module from different sources such as filename, stream, or reader adapter.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a serialized torch Module from an input stream or filename, with optional extra files and debug options.

methods.name: jitModuleFromSourceAndConstants
methods.description: Creates a torch Module from source IValue, source files, constants, and version.

methods.name: parse_and_initialize_jit_module
methods.description: Parses raw data and initializes a jit module with optional extra files and device.

methods.name: load_jit_module_from_file
methods.description: Loads a JIT module from a file with optional extra files and device.

methods.name: load_jit_module_from_stream
methods.description: Loads a JIT module from a stream with optional extra files and device.

methods.name: ObjLoaderFunc
methods.description: Function for loading an object value from a given type and input IValue.
